newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open higher as sentiment remains firm.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open higher as sentiment remains firm.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened slightly higher on Tuesday, as firm sentiment continued after the key market index closed at a high for 1997 on the previous day.
The market was also supported by expectations that new inflows of money will come from public pension funds soon, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average was up 39.60 points or 0.19 percent at 20,720.67 after the first 10 minutes of trade. But September Nikkei futures stood 60 points lower at 20,760.
